title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Rob Parker doubts Red Sox will sustain success to make 2026 playoffs despite recent strong performance.
Red Sox achieved historic run, winning 32 of last 38 games, improving playoff chances to 96% per FanGraphs.
Boston holds second A.L. wild-card spot, trailing Yankees by 1.5 games; Parker remains skeptical of playoff berth.

title: Chad Tracy ‘hopeful’ Wilyer Abreu is back in Red Sox lineup Sunday
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Wilyer Abreu was scratched from the Red Sox lineup Saturday due to swelling from a leg injury sustained Friday.
Manager Chad Tracy is optimistic Abreu will return to the lineup for Sunday's game against the Athletics.
Abreu has contributed significantly this season with 20 home runs and 62 RBIs, maintaining a .256 batting average.

title: Red Sox’ latest winning streak ends at 9 games after loss to Athletics
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: The Boston Red Sox lost 7-3 to the Athletics, ending their nine-game winning streak.
Starting pitcher Jake Bennett allowed four earned runs in 5.1 innings, contributing to Boston's defeat.
The Red Sox maintain a nine-series winning streak and hold the AL's second wild-card spot.

title: Here’s why Gillette Stadium is swapping out its turf surface again so soon after the World Cup
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Gillette Stadium is replacing its recently installed turf due to NFL procedural rules.
The new turf must pass a specific NFL laboratory test missed due to scheduling constraints.
Kraft Sports Group requested an updated test, but NFL scheduled it for early 2027.

title: 4 takeaways from the Revolution’s loss vs. Houston Dynamo
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: New England Revolution lost 2-0 to Houston Dynamo at Gillette Stadium.
Jack Harrison debuted for the Revolution, entering in the 55th minute.
Houston capitalized on New England's defensive errors, scoring from Guilherme and Agustin Resch.

title: Here’s the latest injury updates on Roman Anthony, Adley Rutschman
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Roman Anthony is ramping up recovery from a wrist injury, hitting off a pitching machine with higher velocities.
Adley Rutschman played five innings in a rehab game for the Worcester Red Sox and caught stealing in his debut.
The Red Sox, amid a 9-game winning streak, are set to enhance their lineup with returns of Anthony and Rutschman.

title: New on Netflix and more: Top streaming picks for August 2026
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: Netflix features 'Clueless', 'Eighth Grade', and 'Something's Gotta Give' among top streaming picks for August 2026.
New releases include 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' on Paramount+ and 'The Ballad of Wallis Island' on Peacock.
Boston.com staff recommends 'Star Trek: Strange New Worlds' Season 4 and 'Ted Lasso' Season 4 for August streaming.

title: An 8-foot Bigfoot was spotted in Connecticut last month. It’s far from New England’s first.
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: A Bigfoot sighting was reported by Kevin Klimas in Voluntown, Connecticut on July 5, 2026.
BFRO has verified 126 Bigfoot sightings in New England since 1994, including the recent Connecticut report.
Experts remain skeptical, citing lack of scientific evidence for the existence of Bigfoot.

title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
author: Meredith Goldstein
bullets: Margo Howard, daughter of Ann Landers and advice columnist, passed away last month at 86.
Howard wrote 'Dear Prudence' for Slate and 'Dear Margo' for The Boston Globe.
Her advice emphasized moving past grief and finding happiness beyond personal losses.

title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Payton Tolle struck out a career-high 14 batters, allowing two hits over six innings in Red Sox's 13-1 victory.
The Red Sox offense accumulated 15 hits, scoring multiple runs in the second and fourth innings to secure the win.
Boston extended its winning streak to nine games, improving their season record to 64-51 after defeating the Athletics.
